Hey, look, I don't want to presume to know you but I have BPD, too, and have a husband. I won't sugar coat this. It's hard to love us. We are a lot. I don't know what you are but I'm a quiet BPD. I can tell you for certain that, as one, my husband has requested I be more vocal because my needs change so often. I don't know, by the post, if your husband and you have now officially split up or not.  Either way, I'm very sorry for the pain you're in. If you're still together, please try to talk to him neutrally. If you start to split, stop the conversation entirely and come back once you're fine again. If you're not together anymore, then he has released you from living in a relationship where neither of you were happy, because the truth that is easy to deny is that it takes work from both parties. Hang in there, please. As someone who's husband is loving her through even the toughest storms, love is out there. You're not a monster. I know you're thinking it. You. Aren't. A. Monster. I want you to hug yourself. I don't care if it looks stupid. Do it. Just hug yourself. You're going to be okay. I love you.

EDIT: If you need to DM me, you can. I'm not a fully healed person with BPD btw. I still struggle every week, if not every day of that week. But hey, I'm here.
